description: This file is a PHP template used for rendering an admin interface form to select a blog post to display in the website's footer. It retrieves published posts from the Blog Post model and builds a form with a dropdown menu to choose a post, including some hidden fields for form submission handling.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Model class representing blog posts, used here to fetch all published posts.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Static method to retrieve all posts with a specified publication status.
